units: metres; terrain-local XZ; height Y relative to the StrataTerrain3D origin

volumes.height: required scalar volume, any dense orthogonal horizontal lattice up to 4097 samples per axis (absolute terrain-local metres). Send the complete stack (cumulative through the last height layer) resampled with terrain_spacing, e.g. 4 m = 1025^2 over 4 km, never a fine manual layer's native 0.25 m lattice.

outputs.lattice: exactly the input height lattice (same resolution, origin and steps); no resampling
outputs.routing: prim attributes hegostrata_layer_path = target_layer_path, hegostrata_role = value, hegostrata_channel = name, hegostrata_composition = replace
outputs.diagnostics: detail attributes hego_tint_{operator, seconds, samples, spacing_a, spacing_b, seed, min[4], max[4], mean[4]} (r, g, b, ao); never routed

algorithm.gaussian: G_s(h): three box-filter passes per axis approximating a Gaussian of sigma s metres on each axis's physical step; boundary samples extend outward
algorithm.cavity: 0.65 * smoothstep(0, ao_ratio, (G_r(h) - h) / r) + 0.35 * smoothstep(0, ao_ratio, (G_4r(h) - h) / 4r), r = ao_radius
algorithm.terrain_ao: 1 - ao_strength * cavity. A cavity-derived approximation from the local mean height, not ray-traced visibility or horizon occlusion.
algorithm.validation: every float parameter must be finite and inside its documented range, seed 0..100000, steps finite and nonzero (node error otherwise; values set through HAPI are re-checked inside the cook)
algorithm.variation: n = 3-octave value-noise fBm on world XZ (variation_scale, seed), w = 0.5 * variation_strength * fBm(1.7 * variation_scale, seed + 1); identical at a world point for any lattice
algorithm.tint: b = (1 + ridge_strength * ridge) * (1 + variation_strength * n); tint = (b * (1 + w), b, b * (1 - w))
algorithm.no_double_darkening: Cavities are darkened only through terrain_ao; the tint never depends on concavity (ridge >= 0 only brightens). No directional or baked sun lighting.

target_layer_path.notes: Scene path of the mask-only procedural StrataLayer; empty -> node error

ridge_ratio.notes: about the land p95 of the 4 km island at 4 m

ao_ratio.notes: about the land p95 cavity depth ratio of the eroded island

cook_policy: Explicit cook only (no auto cook). The tint stage never changes height; it is a mask-only layer above the height stages.
